source.title: Answering Water's Call
source.description:
Strong spirit. You help stop corruption.

<Water rages as it swirls around the elemental.>

Bretheren. Elements of Feralas help. Essence will find Shrine.

Fragment help too. Cleanse corruption.
source.objective:
Collect 3 Elemental Essence from the water elementals on The Forgotten Coast across from Sardor Isle in Feralas and combine them with the Fragment of Water to summon help at the corrupted shrine there.

Provided item:
source.completion: Cleanse shrine now. Not strong enough. Need others. Other elements.
